proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for nzbget, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the nzbget service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the nzbget
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  nzbget:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.nzbget.loadbalancer.server.port=6789
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.rule=Host(`nzbget.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.service=nzbget
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.nzbget.middlewares=authentik@docker
      # API paths stay open so client applications keep working.
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget-api.rule=Host(`nzbget.example.com`) && (PathPrefix(`/jsonrpc`) || PathPrefix(`/jsonprpc`) || PathPrefix(`/xmlrpc`))
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget-api.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget-api.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget-api.service=nzbget
      - traefik.http.routers.nzbget-api.priority=100
proxy.base_url_note: NZBGet answers under any path prefix; nothing to change

subfolder.base_url_note: NZBGet answers under any path prefix; nothing to change

kubernetes:
# Nzbget: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-nzbget/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
#   - runAsNonRoot is supported by this image (set runAsUser and drop PUID/PGID).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nzbget-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: nzbget-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nzbget
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nzbget
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/nzbget:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nzbget-env
        ports:
        - name: port-6789
          containerPort: 6789
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: nzbget-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: nzbget-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: nzbget-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nzbget
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: nzbget
  ports:
  - name: port-6789
    port: 6789
    targetPort: 6789
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# nzbget.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-nzbget/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Nzbget (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/nzbget:latest
ContainerName=nzbget
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=NZBGET_USER=nzbget
# Environment=NZBGET_PASS=tegbzn6789
Volume=/path/to/nzbget/data:/config:Z
# Volume=/path/to/downloads:/downloads:Z
PublishPort=6789:6789

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
